page.overview:
Who is Vorn Hagan?

Vorn Hagan is a former Chapter Master of the Imperial Fists Chapter.

He was chosen to succeed Vladimir Pugh, the previous Chapter Master, after Pugh was killed in battle against the Tyranids during the Infestation of Drashin in 970.M41.

Vorn Hagen, who was originally the captain of the Imperial Fists 5th Company, was selected as the new Imperial Fists Chapter Master over First Captain Darnath Lysander.

Lysander refused the honour as he felt he would lead the Chapter to ruin unless he was able to master his own personal failings and successfully bring his righteous vengeance down upon the Iron Warriors Warsmith Shon'tu who had caused him so much torment.
